recognize_zh: 軟組織腫塊中可見斜向穿過的粉紅色骨骼肌纖維被大量大型腫瘤細胞包圍浸潤；腫瘤細胞核不規則、染色質呈芽細胞樣，部分胞質嗜酸性，且有纖維血管隔分隔，符合原發部位的肺泡型橫紋肌肉瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of large round to oval tumor cells infiltrating between entrapped, diagonally oriented eosinophilic skeletal muscle fibers
Irregular hyperchromatic nuclei with blastic chromatin, focal nuclear molding and scattered mitoses/apoptotic bodies
Scant to moderate pale eosinophilic, sometimes vacuolated cytoplasm; occasional larger cells with more abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm (rhabdomyoblast-like)
Thin fibrovascular septa traversing the tumor
describe_en: High-power hematoxylin and eosin-stained section of a forearm soft-tissue mass shows sheets of large, discohesive malignant cells infiltrating around entrapped skeletal muscle fibers that course diagonally across the field. The tumor cells have irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei with blastic chromatin, scant to moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and occasional cells with more abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm; mitotic and apoptotic figures are present. Thin fibrovascular septa separate groups of cells, although a well-formed alveolar pattern is not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with a malignant small round blue cell tumor, in keeping with alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma when supported by desmin and diffuse myogenin staining.

ddx.vs: Embryonal RMS shows variably cellular myxoid stroma with spindle cells and patchy myogenin, lacking the fibrovascular septa and diffuse myogenin/FOXO1 fusion of the alveolar type.
Ewing sarcoma cells are more uniform with fine chromatin and clear cytoplasm, CD99/NKX2.2 positive and myogenin negative.

ddx.dx: Lymphoblastic or Burkitt lymphoma of soft tissue
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are CD45 positive with B/T lineage markers and TdT (lymphoblastic) or CD10/MYC (Burkitt), and desmin/myogenin negative.
Myeloid sarcoma may contain eosinophilic myelocytes and is MPO, CD33, CD117 or lysozyme positive.
